title: 第三十三章 夜馆私语八强遇旧敌第三十二章 梵脉现世骨血旧烙印
lines: 夜幕彻底吞没永安郡城。
漫天碎星嵌在墨色天幕，比武广场灯火次第熄灭，白日擂台上的剑鸣杀伐、梵力轰鸣尽数散去，只剩晚风掠过青石台面，带走残留梵煞交织的气息。
本届武道盛会八强名单敲定，连夜张贴于广场公示石壁之上，鎏金刻字，照亮全场。
首位：镇北侯府，沈砚。
余下七人，分别是郡守府周清鸢、黑石城新晋天骄厉穹、城西武宗少宗主、冥阁外围首席死士寒影，外加三名依附冥阁的本土宗门天才。
一目了然，八强格局七对一。
除去周清鸢一人中立，其余六人，尽数听命云来客栈夜衍，全员围堵沈砚。
广场散场人流络绎不绝，往来武者边走边热议，话题从头到尾，从未离开青衫少年。
“谁能想到最后翻盘的不是蛟脉，是沈砚心口那道银色秘印，连先天梵脉都能镇压！”
“清风宗楚凌太可惜了，本身心性不坏，纯粹被冥阁拿捏宗门老小，被逼出战，属实身不由己。”
“接下来八强淘汰赛就是死局，六个对手全是冥阁棋子，沈砚就算再强，也难一打六，除非郡守之女彻底站队帮他。”
议论声随风消散，侯府一行人返程城西专属驿馆。
驿馆内设聚灵庭院，假山流水清幽静谧，院内布设隔音结界，隔绝外界窥探耳目，是郡守府特意划拨的安全院落，避开冥阁眼线探查。
廊下灯笼暖光摇曳，映得石桌旁少年青衫染浅血痕，白日擂台激战留下的破损衣料还未更换，小臂鳞甲褪去后，浅浅梵力淤痕清晰可见。
沈砚慵懒落座石凳，指尖摩挲衣襟内侧，触碰那道转瞬即可隐匿的银色宿命印，眸色淡淡，复盘白日擂台所有疑点。
白日印纹觉醒刹那，夜衍神色失态、改口上报总部、不敢动手杀他，足以证明一件事：宿命印比碧鳞蛟脉，层级更高，关乎冥阁顶层秘辛。
原本只是为寻双亲、躲避抓捕，如今莫名卷入远古印纹棋局，被动入局，身不由己。
“公子，抬手。”
清脆女声打断思绪，阿禾端着白玉疗伤药碗快步走来，小脸鼓着气，眉眼满是心疼，蹲下身直接拉住沈砚手腕，动作熟练又自然。
瓷碗内药膏莹白温润，专门化解梵力淤毒，是秦守长老特意调配的高阶疗伤药膏。
沈砚顺势抬臂，语气平淡随性：“伤势不重，不必麻烦。”
“还不重？”阿禾当即抬眼，挑眉怼回去，指尖轻轻点了点他小臂伤口，语气俏皮带嗔，“百多道剑伤，梵力钻骨，白天硬扛楚凌梵剑的时候怎么不怕疼？现在反倒嫌麻烦，公子能不能别总把自己往死里逼？”
从小相伴长大，全府唯独阿禾，敢这般直白数落沈砚。
沈砚眸底冷意散去几分，唇角微不可察弯了一下，低声妥协：“知道了，不硬扛。”
一旁伫立观战的执法长老秦守见状，无奈摇头失笑，心底感慨。
外界人人敬畏杀伐果断、心性冷硬的沈砚，唯有在阿禾面前，才会卸下所有锋芒，温顺退让，这也是少年为数不多的软肋。
“长老，清风宗那边，后续如何？”沈砚顺势转移话题，回归正事。
白日楚凌落败，等同于彻底忤逆冥阁指令，依照夜衍狠戾心性，今夜必定清算清风宗。
秦守面色收敛笑意，沉声回话：“刚刚收到眼线消息，夜衍留了清风宗活路，但是扣押清风宗宗主为人质，勒令楚凌明日八强抽签，必须亲手对你出手，不限手段，务必重创你。”
“又是胁迫。”沈砚眸光微凉。
从头到尾，冥阁惯用拿捏至亲、宗门羁绊逼迫天骄站队，黑石城、清风宗，无一例外。
“楚凌本心不坏。”沈砚客观评判。
“的确不坏，只是身不由己。”一道清雅女声顺着晚风传来，语调轻柔好听，自带温润质感。
庭院拱门处，白衣少女缓步走入。
周清鸢褪去擂台劲装，换上一身素雅月白长裙，长发松松挽起，玉簪束发，褪去赛场剑意，多了几分温婉灵气，手里拎着一只雕花檀木小药盒，孤身走入结界院内。
驿馆护卫认出郡守府服饰，不敢阻拦，直接放行。
阿禾抬头看向来人，瞬间收敛俏皮神态，礼貌起身行礼，眼底却悄悄升起一丝戒备。
这位郡守千金，武道天赋顶尖，观气秘术通天，数次擂台出手相助，对公子太过特殊。
“周小姐深夜到访，有事？”沈砚抬眸直视来人，语气不冷不热，分寸适中。
周清鸢径直走到石桌对面落座，将檀木药盒推到沈砚面前，眉眼弯弯，笑意干净灵动，互动氛围感拉满：“没事就不能来？沈公子白天擂台舍命破局，满身伤痕，我来送药，不算逾矩吧？”
盒内药膏纹路精致，灵气醇厚，品级远超阿禾手中疗伤药膏，是郡守府珍藏的梵愈膏，专门化解先天梵力、域外煞力双重余毒，有价无市。
content_en:
Night completely engulfed Yongan County.
The sky was full of broken stars embedded in the ink sky. The lights in the competition square were extinguished one after another. The swords and the roar of Brahma in the arena during the day were all dispersed. Only the evening breeze passed over the bluestone table, taking away the remaining intertwined breath of Brahma and evil spirits.
The list of the top eight for this year's martial arts event was finalized and posted overnight on the stone wall of the square with gilt inscriptions, illuminating the entire venue.
First place: Zhenbei Hou Mansion, Shen Yan.
The remaining seven people are Zhou Qingyuan, the governor of the county, Li Qiong, the new prodigy of Black Rock City, the young master of Wuzong in the west of the city, Han Ying, the chief dead soldier outside Ming Pavilion, plus three local sect geniuses who are attached to Ming Pavilion.
It is clear at a glance that the top eight are seven against one.
Except for Zhou Qingyuan, who was neutral, the other six people all obeyed Yun Lai's inn Ye Yan, and all surrounded Shen Yan.
There was an endless flow of people after the square was over, and the warriors were chatting hotly as they walked. The topic never left the young man in green shirt from beginning to end.
"Who would have thought that it wasn't the Jiao Vein that would turn the tables in the end, but the silver secret seal on Shen Yan's heart, which could suppress even the innate Brahma Vein!"
"It's such a pity that Qingfeng Sect Chu Ling has a good character. He was simply manipulated by Ming Pavilion and forced to fight. He really couldn't help himself."
"The next eight quarter-finals will be a dead end. All six opponents are Ming Pavilion pawns. No matter how strong Shen Yan is, it will be difficult for him to defeat six of them, unless the county guard's daughter completely stands up to help him."
The discussion disappeared with the wind, and the Hou family returned to the exclusive post house in the west of the city.
The post house has a gathering courtyard with rockery and flowing water, which is quiet and quiet. There is a soundproof barrier in the courtyard to isolate it from prying eyes and ears from the outside world. It is a safe courtyard specially allocated by the county governor's office to avoid the spy of Ming Pavilion.
The warm light of the lanterns in the corridor swayed, reflecting the young man's green shirt beside the stone table stained with light blood stains. The damaged clothing left by the fierce battle in the arena during the day had not been replaced. After the scales on the forearms faded, the shallow bruises of Brahma energy were clearly visible.
Shen Yan lazily sat down on the stone bench. His fingertips rubbed the inside of his clothes, touching the silver seal of fate that could be hidden in an instant. His eyes were light as he reviewed all the doubts in the arena during the day.
The moment the day mark awakened, Ye Yan lost his composure, changed his story and reported it to the headquarters, and did not dare to kill him, which is enough to prove one thing: the fate mark is higher than the green scale dragon veins, and is related to the top secrets of the Ming Pavilion.
Originally he was just looking for his parents and evading capture, but now he is inexplicably involved in the ancient imprint chess game, passively entering the game and unable to control himself.
"Sir, raise your hands."
A clear female voice interrupted his thoughts. Ah He walked quickly with a bowl of white jade healing medicine. His little face was bulging, and his eyebrows were full of distress. He squatted down and directly grabbed Shen Yan's wrist, his movements were skillful and natural.
The ointment in the porcelain bowl is white and warm, specially designed to resolve Brahma stasis. It is a high-level healing ointment specially formulated by Elder Qin Shou.
Shen Yan raised his arm and said in a calm and casual tone: "The injury is not serious, no need to bother."
"Isn't it heavy?" Ah He immediately raised his eyes, raised his eyebrows and snarled back. He lightly tapped the wound on his forearm with his fingertips, his tone was playful and angry, "More than a hundred sword wounds, the Brahma force drilled into the bones. Why weren't you afraid of pain when you were carrying the Chu Ling Brahma Sword during the day? Now it's troublesome. Master, can you stop pushing yourself to death?"
They have grown up with each other since childhood, and Ahe is the only one in the whole family who dares to criticize Shen Yan so bluntly.
The coldness in Shen Yan's eyes dissipated a little, the corners of his lips curved slightly, and he compromised in a low voice: "I know, I won't bear it."
When Qin Shou, the law enforcement elder who was standing aside to watch the battle, saw this, he shook his head helplessly and laughed, feeling deeply in his heart.
Everyone in the outside world respects Shen Yan, who is decisive in killing and cold-hearted. Only in front of A He will he drop all his sharpness and meekly give in. This is also one of the young men's few weaknesses.
"Elder, how is the follow-up with Qingfeng Sect?" Shen Yan changed the subject and returned to business.
Chu Ling's defeat during the day was tantamount to complete disobedience to Ming Pavilion's instructions. According to Ye Yan's ruthless character, Qingfeng Sect must be liquidated tonight.
Qin Shou suppressed his smile and replied in a deep voice: "I just received news from the informant that Ye Yan has left the Qingfeng Sect alive, but he has taken the leader of the Qingfeng Sect as a hostage and ordered Chu Ling to draw lots for the top eight tomorrow. He must attack you with his own hands. No matter what method he uses, he must hit you hard."
"Another intimidation." Shen Yan's eyes were slightly cold.
From the beginning to the end, Ming Pavilion used to manipulate close relatives and sect ties to force Tianjiao to take sides. Black Rock City and Qingfeng Sect were no exception.
"Chu Ling's heart is not bad." Shen Yan judged objectively.
"It's not bad, I just can't help myself." An elegant female voice came along the evening breeze, her tone was soft and pleasant, with a warm texture.
At the archway of the courtyard, the girl in white walked slowly in.
Zhou Qingyuan took off her ring attire and put on a simple and elegant moon-white dress. Her long hair was rolled up loosely and tied with a hosta. She lost the sword spirit of the competition and gained a bit of gentleness. She walked into the barrier courtyard alone with a small carved sandalwood medicine box in her hand.
The guards of the post house recognized the county magistrate's clothes and did not dare to stop them, so they let him go directly.
Ah He raised his head to look at the person who came, and instantly stopped his playful demeanor. He politely stood up and saluted, but a hint of wariness quietly appeared in his eyes.
This daughter of the county guard is extremely talented in martial arts and possesses the secret skills of observing Qi. She has helped him several times in the arena. She is too special for the young master.
"Ms. Zhou is here late at night, what's wrong?" Shen Yan raised his eyes and looked directly at the visitor, his tone was lukewarm and moderate.
Zhou Qingyuan walked straight to the stone table and sat down, pushing the sandalwood medicine box in front of Shen Yan. His eyebrows were curved, his smile was clean and smart, and the interactive atmosphere was full: "You can't come if you have nothing to do? Mr. Shen sacrificed his life in the ring during the day and was covered with scars. I came to deliver medicine. Isn't it an overstep?"
The ointment in the box has exquisite textures and mellow spiritual energy, and its grade is far superior to the healing ointment in Ah He's hand. It is the Brahma Healing Ointment treasured by the County Sheriff's Mansion. It is specially designed to resolve the dual residual poisons of innate Brahma power and foreign evil forces. It is valuable but not marketable.
title_en: Chapter 33: Whispers in the nightclub The top eight meet old enemies Chapter 32: Brahma vein appears and the old mark of flesh and blood appears
